name: Yanming
intro: I am currently a research intern at HKU MMLab, mentored by Prof. Ping Luo. Previously, I interned at Shanghai AI Lab and Shanghai Jiao Tong University, mentored by Prof. Yao Mu.
My research focuses on dexterous manipulation and embodied recursive self-improvement (Embodied RSI).
vision: I am especially interested in the first successful trajectory on a difficult manipulation task. When its current policy fails, can a robot use interaction feedback to revise its control code and compose existing skills into a solution?

My goal is to use real and synthetic human data to expand the tasks and environments robots can explore. Through self-harness, an agent would refine its tools, code, memory, and skills. Successful trajectories could then be distilled into action models, which become tools for further exploration. I want to understand how this cycle can scale toward human-level dexterity.
motto: The sea advances imperceptibly and without a sound. Nothing seems to break; nothing moves. The water is so far away that one can barely hear it… Yet it eventually surrounds the resistant substance, which little by little becomes a peninsula, then an island, then an islet, and is finally submerged in turn, as though dissolved in the ocean stretching as far as the eye can see.
